court_record_independent.decisive_finding: ICFR / auditor red flag the verify pass MISSED. The FY2025 ICFR audit opinion was ADVERSE (EisnerAmper attested ICFR was NOT effective) and management CONCURRED -- FOUR MATERIAL WEAKNESSES, disclosed in FY25 10-K Item 9A + reaffirmed in Q1-FY26 10-Q: (i) no effective entity-level / business-process controls; (ii) insufficient documentation of management-review controls across ALL financial-statement areas; (iii) no effective risk-assessment/monitoring controls (3 of the 5 COSO pillars -- the 'top of the house'); (iv) insufficient documentation of change-management/logical-access controls over the TIMEKEEPING systems that drive staffing revenue. Disclosure controls concluded NOT EFFECTIVE as of Apr-4-2026 and STILL UNREMEDIATED ~15mo after the identification date (remediation only 'commenced/planned'). AUDITOR BOOMERANG: on Apr-29-2026 (26 days after the FY25 10-K was filed) RCMT DISMISSED EisnerAmper and RE-ENGAGED WithumSmith+Brown (the FY22-24 predecessor) -> Withum->Eisner->Withum in three filing cycles. 8-K 4.01 (acc 0000929638-26-001752) states no disagreements. FORK CALIBRATION (escalation, Opus full-context): NOT opinion-shopping -- EisnerAmper had ALREADY rendered BOTH the clean financial opinion AND the adverse ICFR opinion before being fired, so firing it retracts nothing; ~70% messy-but-benign rotation/fee/independence reversion to the long-time incumbent vs ~30% ICFR-friction contributed; but the merry-go-round on a Vizi-controlled 3-independent board is itself a governance-quality yellow flag. SEVERITY ~65th pct of 'bad' -- 'real, adverse, still-open entity-level control weakness + auditor instability', NOT a smoking gun. TRUST IMPACT: clean financial opinion + adverse ICFR = numbers are 'audited-reliable to the auditor's substantive-testing threshold, NOT system-reliable'; management concedes the weaknesses 'could lead to a misstatement of substantially all account balances or disclosures'; residual risk concentrates on fixed-price cost-to-complete (23% of rev / $73.2M, the Critical Audit Matter) + timekeeping-driven revenue = the Engineering re-inflection + margin lines. NO restatement / no out-of-period error correction disclosed yet (only a benign Q2-FY25 segment-cost re-presentation, both periods recast) -> tail ELEVATED not realized. The thesis explicitly claimed 'the marketed takeaway does not diverge from the audited numbers' with ZERO mention of the adverse ICFR or the auditor change -> a genuine completeness / takeaway-vs-data OMISSION.

red_team.5_base_rates: RESOLVED (dedicated base-rates sub-agent + my own tape): the 're-rate' leg is BASE-RATE-UNSUPPORTED. (a) PEERS: RCMT ~8.6-9.0x EV/EBIT / ~8.3x EV/EBITDA is IN-LINE-TO-FULL, not cheap; cleanest comp ASGN ~8.4x (bigger/better/more liquid) at parity; the '18-24x peer' citations are trough-earnings artifacts (KFRC EBITDA collapsed, CCRN negative). (b) OWN HISTORY: ~12% ABOVE its own 5yr avg, high end of its 6-9x band, after a 6x run ($4->$27) + 35% YTD. CLINCHER: EV PEAKED ~$256M in 2023 and is ~$228M NOW -- BELOW its 2-year-ago level DESPITE record revenue; EV/EBIT COMPRESSED 9.6x FY24 -> 6.9x at FY25 YE as earnings rose (the ~6.9x is at the ~$18 FY25-YE stock price; my 8.6-8.8x is at the current $27.55 -- both consistent, the stock re-rated up ONLY on the +35% YTD move, not on a durable multiple award). The multiple went DOWN as EBIT went up = the opposite of a re-rate. (c) ACTIVIST/BUYBACK BASE RATE: re-rating is the EXCEPTION -- cash-returning cannibals (AutoZone/NVR/Teledyne-Singleton) compound at a FLAT multiple; genuine re-raters (TerraVest/Constellation/Domino's) re-rated because the market discovered a REINVESTMENT machine or normalized off DISTRESS -- RCMT is neither. Closest sector analog Mastech Digital (MHH) = a documented ~8x value trap. Academic: deHaan-Larcker-McClure (activist long-term VW returns ~0, gains via ACQUISITION of tiny targets), Grullon-Michaely (buyback firms' growth DETERIORATES), Bajzik meta (effect ~0-1.5%), GS bump-then-fade (16->18->16x). (d) Even the BULLS underwrite no re-rate (Gilmour ~7x P/E, Simply Wall St forward P/E ticks DOWN). PRECISION CORRECTION (adopt): RCMT is NOT a melting ice cube -- revenue genuinely grew $204M->$319M, ROE ~40%, ROIC ~24%; the fair frame is 'a good high-ROIC disciplined cannibal the market STRUCTURALLY caps at ~7-9x because it's cyclical staffing'. Base-rates agent's standalone class = RP_FAIR (ownable for buyback+growth CARRY at a flat multiple, NO edge). COURT OVERLAY: RP_FAIR is the pre-ICFR read; the open adverse-ICFR defect at a FULL multiple pushes it to WAIT (you don't own even a fair-carry name while it carries an unpriced ~25% restatement tail with no margin of safety).
